about_the_game:
AlphaFurry Official Soundtrack: Immerse Yourself in the Howl of the Night!

Step into the world of AlphaFurry with this exclusive official soundtrack! Featuring 14 powerful and atmospheric tracks, this collection brings the essence of werewolves to life, mystical, intense, and full of raw energy.

Whether you're reliving your favorite moments from the game or simply craving an unforgettable listening experience, these MP3 tracks will transport you straight into the heart of the wild.

Unleash the beast within and let the music guide you!

content_descriptors.notes: While AlphaFurry may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or workplace environments, the Official Soundtrack is completely free of mature content. This music collection is safe for all listeners and focuses purely on the immersive, atmospheric sounds of the game.
